mintAuthority.summary: SPKCC has issuer-native mint authority on seven deployments: Spiko's PermissionManager gates mint() on Ethereum, Polygon, Arbitrum, Base and Etherlink, while Starknet uses a 3-of-5 multisig owner and Stellar uses a single ed25519 owner. EVM group 0 can grant the daily-operator group and replace both the token and PermissionManager implementation. Etherlink group 0 is held by a 3-of-6 Safe, not the deployment EOA previously recorded. No deployment encodes a supply cap and no path carries a timelock.

upgradeability.controlRef: Spiko ADMIN group Safe (Ethereum and Base)

controls.label: SPKCC token (UUPS proxy, mint restricted to PermissionManager groups 0 and 2)
controls.evidence: Ethereum EIP-1967 impl slot = 0x15ea0ec460a0e6847ec0aa8d50a84b3a51b95f74 (Token.sol); authority() = PermissionManager proxy 0x344278aff344d6fb960705dc18a4912221608472; getRequirements(token, mint(address,uint256) 0x40c10f19) = 0x05 = groups {0, 2}. The same shape was re-read on 2026-07-20 on Arbitrum (token 0x99f70a0e1786402a6796c6b0aa997ef340a5c6da, impl 0xa0769f7a8fc65e47de93797b4e21c073c117fc80, authority 0xa925c217e4c1c82ee721ebd496d3863d5c2d829a, block 485916291), Polygon (token 0x903d5990119bc799423e9c25c56518ba7dd19474, impl 0x15ea0ec460a0e6847ec0aa8d50a84b3a51b95f74, authority 0x344278aff344d6fb960705dc18a4912221608472, block 90573534) and Base (token 0xf695df6c0f3bb45918a7a82e83348fc59517734e, same impl and authority, block 48887968). Every EVM deployment returns getRequirements(mint) = {0,2}. The token itself carries no supply cap; issuance is gated only by group membership.

controls.label: SPKCC Etherlink token (UUPS proxy, mint restricted to PermissionManager groups 0 and 2)
controls.evidence: The official chain-42793 deployment cache identifies SPKCC at 0x4f33acf823e6eeb697180d553ce0c710124c8d59 and its PermissionManager at 0x344278aff344d6fb960705dc18a4912221608472. At Etherlink block 51158914, the proxy returned symbol() = SPKCC, authority() = that PermissionManager and EIP-1967 implementation = 0xa8de1f55aa0e381cb456e1dcc9ff781ea0079068. Verified Spiko Token.sol applies PermissionManager-gated mint semantics; this deployment has no encoded supply cap.

controls.label: Spiko PermissionManager (ERC1967 proxy) - shared authority policy
controls.evidence: ERC1967 impl = 0xd3f5f1524e1a472b51374a3ff41b8936eb5b658e. ADMIN() = 0 and PUBLIC() = 255. getGroupAdmins(0) = 0x01 (group 0 administers itself) and getGroupAdmins(2) = 0x01, so the ADMIN group alone can add or remove the daily-operator minter group. getRequirements(token, upgradeToAndCall 0x4f1ef286) = 0x01 and getRequirements(permissionManager, upgradeToAndCall) = 0x01: the ADMIN group alone can replace both the token and the PermissionManager implementation. On Arbitrum the deployment uses proxy 0xa925c217e4c1c82ee721ebd496d3863d5c2d829a with the same implementation bytecode; Polygon and Base reuse the 0x3442...8472 address.

controls.label: Spiko Etherlink PermissionManager (ERC1967 proxy) - shared authority policy
controls.evidence: At Etherlink block 54659751, PermissionManager 0x344278aff344d6fb960705dc18a4912221608472 returns ADMIN group 0 for Safe 0x09991fbf6b16741f6fde3b1c16e8e4d95a5e5538 and only PUBLIC for former deployment EOA 0xed608cf38968c0ba09676843d90b33dd59dd7375. The prior 2026-08-16 current-EOA assertion is superseded by pinned state and explorer GroupAdded/GroupRemoved history. ADMIN can authorize minters and replace implementations without an encoded supply cap or timelock.

controls.label: Spiko ADMIN group Safe (Ethereum and Base)
controls.evidence: Ethereum getGroups(0x4eaa52b6280593a8820c45ce38f974290ae52cea) = 0x8000...0001, i.e. ADMIN group 0 plus the PUBLIC group. Read at block 25575165: Safe v1.4.1 proxy (171-byte), getThreshold() = 3, getOwners() = 6 signers, singleton slot 0 = 0x41675C099F32341bf84BFc5382aF534df5C7461a, guard slot zero and getModulesPaginated returns an empty module list. The same address is the sole group-0 holder on Base (block 48888063, singleton 0x29fcB43b46531BcA003ddC8FCB67FFE91900C762, threshold 3, 6 owners, no guard or modules). This supersedes a 2026-07-20 record of 8 signers: two of the addresses in that record were malformed and the live Safe returns 6 owners.

controls.label: Spiko ADMIN group Safe (Arbitrum)
controls.evidence: Full GroupAdded/GroupRemoved replay from block 0 on the Arbitrum PermissionManager 0xa925c217e4c1c82ee721ebd496d3863d5c2d829a resolves group 0 to exactly one address, 0x7843225ba488cf780a4fe2c842b5dc2abcf8a03e, confirmed by getGroups() = 0x8000...0001. Read at block 485897632: Safe v1.4.1, getThreshold() = 3, getOwners() = 6 signers, singleton 0x29fcB43b46531BcA003ddC8FCB67FFE91900C762, no guard, no enabled modules. Group 2 (daily-operator minters) holds 6 addresses on Arbitrum.

controls.label: Spiko ADMIN group Safe (Polygon)
controls.evidence: Full GroupAdded/GroupRemoved replay from block 0 on the Polygon PermissionManager 0x344278aff344d6fb960705dc18a4912221608472 (2182 additions, 213 removals) resolves group 0 to exactly one address, 0xa4196f06fe948b8ca81d3dc77110d3f83d10abd9, confirmed by getGroups() = 0x8000...0001. Read at block 90573650: Safe v1.4.1, getThreshold() = 3, getOwners() = 6 signers, singleton 0x29fcB43b46531BcA003ddC8FCB67FFE91900C762, no guard, no enabled modules. Group 2 (minters) holds 6 addresses.

controls.label: Spiko Etherlink ADMIN group Safe
controls.evidence: At Etherlink block 54659751, getGroups(Safe)=0x8000...0001 (ADMIN plus PUBLIC), getOwners() returns six owners, getThreshold()=3, VERSION()=1.4.1, module pagination is empty, guard storage is zero, fallback handler is 0xfd0732...ec99 and singleton is 0x29fcb4...c762. The previously recorded deployment EOA 0xed608c...7375 has only PUBLIC membership and no current ADMIN authority. Historical 2026-08-16 EOA assertions are superseded; the Safe can still authorize minters and replace mint-critical logic with no encoded supply cap or timelock.

controls.label: Spiko SPKCC Starknet owner multisig
controls.evidence: Read 2026-07-20 at Starknet block ~12085372: SPKCC contract 0x04bade88e79a6120f893d64e51006ac6853eceeefa1a50868d19601b1f0a567d (class 0x5973b1bed1f0a20a9125fac8ec5499f29f44bb70d9c465658c0da20ca9b75f3) returns decimals 5, total_supply 494,745.84706 and owner() = 0x07bc8bbd7c7fcc89273726fd34bc1ffc4649ed3f2f1be43e12afe8a406a5ca9d. That owner is a multisig account contract (class 0x6e150953b26271a740bf2b6e9bca17cc52c68d765f761295de51ceb8526ee72) with get_threshold() = 3 and get_signers() returning 5 signers. It holds the Starknet mint and class-replacement authority; there is no timelock on the owner path.

controls.label: Spiko SPKCC Soroban owner key (single ed25519 signer)

controls.evidence: The Soroban SPKCC contract CDS2GCAQTNQINSCJUJIVBJXILKBWP5PU7LOBGHMP3X47QCQBFKPMTCNT (WASM hash f48f10d9c7d35fc7783b5e27578bf0e764e3a30ff26a3bd7d8e57758c17a9ea8, unverified source on Stellar Expert) exposes its instance storage directly. Decoded 2026-07-20 it holds METADATA {decimals 5, name 'Spiko Digital Assets Cash and Carry Fund', symbol SPKCC}, TotalSupply 516,408.8251, PERM = CBGHLRSX5D5YMBPNK4ZGMUTJUHFIT7YGXGJURM5LFNZ7B6WNSXLGS26M, REDEEM = CAVZK26ERVGKGXLQGEOKPAQGIZS2YKN4BSXOYDMUY365EV66ZNSFEDBS and Owner = the ed25519 account GBYIQXBKEB655EB3WTRITS6RR5GXEP6SQRBLPREZHNFYKT7WBMTMPR3H, which is also the contract's deployer. Horizon shows that account has a single ed25519 signer at weight 1 with low/med/high thresholds all 0, so the Stellar deployment's owner and WASM-upgrade authority is a single key with no multisig quorum.

review.evidence: The 2026-08-16 review enumerated seven native deployments, EVM PermissionManager mint/upgrade powers, a Starknet 3-of-5 owner, and a Stellar single-key owner. Its Etherlink EOA assertion was incorrect: on 2026-10-01 at Etherlink block 54659751, the recorded EOA has only PUBLIC membership; ADMIN is Safe 0x09991fbf6b16741f6fde3b1c16e8e4d95a5e5538 (3-of-6, v1.4.1, no enabled modules or guard). Explorer events show ADMIN added to that Safe and removed from the deployment EOA at block 0x627a18. Arbitrum and Polygon Safe owner arrays were also refreshed at pinned blocks 510591960 and 94756419; thresholds remain 3-of-6. These corrections do not introduce a mint cap or timelock. Historical reconciliation review (2026-08-08): the February 1, 2026 prospectus appoints CACEIS Fund Administration as daily D+1 NAV accountant, CACEIS Bank as independent depositary and PricewaterhouseCoopers Audit as statutory auditor. The FPS itself is not AMF-authorised; Twenty First Capital SAS is the AMF-authorised management company (GP-11000029). Current source and chain checks preserve the distinction between manager supervision and vehicle authorisation.
